evidence.chinaDemandEvidence: A pausable real-time tactical and resource management sim driven by dynamic battlefield events. War isn't just about combat—it’s about the daily lives of your soldiers. Keep logistics running, scavenge every usable resource, and do what you can to ease the harsh reality of life on the frontlines. “The truth is... less than 1% of war is real fighting. The other 99% is just suffering in the trenches — from shellfire, hunger, disease, and rats.” — An unnamed soldier Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare is a tactical survival and outpost simulation management game driven by various unexpected events on the battlefield. The main inspirations come from Neo Scavenger, Gates of Hell, RimWorld. The story background is inspired by pivotal conflicts in modern history. You will take on the role of the only surviving officer in the company after an enemy airstrike, taking up the responsibility in a crisis, gathering the remnants, and leading the troops through battle after battle to break through the dilemma, gradually growing into an elite force. Gameplay Design It’s more important to play a bad hand well than to be dealt a good one. Through the high-altitude drone combat command platform, you cannot participate in combat personally, but you can observe the real-time situation on the battlefield and quickly update your combat deployments via the drone’s camera. However, there is still a time gap and human factors in the issuing and execution of orders. Sometimes, you must anticipate in advance or radically shift your approach. But plans never keep up with changes — perhaps you should be prepared for your operations to be disrupted. Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare is dedicated to expressing aspects rarely touched upon by other war games: Detailed classification of logistics work. Machine gun ammo belts must be assembled from loose rounds in the ammo workshop before they can be used by gunners; ingredients are cooked into hot meals in the field kitchen; the severely wounded undergo emergency surgery before being transported to the rear for treatment; fallen comrades are recovered, prepared, and sent back. Customizable armament. In war, the only constant is “change”, and that applies to machines too. Not every piece of armament can function like it came out of the factory. When there are no suitable replacement parts, or when you have two tanks each with different damages, “working” is the only requirement — if it can be fixed, it must not be scrapped! In addition, you can also modify your armament to add new functions to suit different battlefield environments. Soldiers who obey orders but retain individuality. Your soldiers execute combat orders strictly, but may also pick up loot amid the hail of bullets. Besides ammunition, their backpacks may also carry “junk” they can’t bear to discard — if deployed near a river, they might even bring back a big fish for the mess hall in the evening. Balanced nutrition, properly rationed. Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare strongly encourages players to enhance the frontline living conditions of their troops in every possible way — and rations are a key part of that. In the game, you can recreate real-world rationing systems used across various theaters of war: rear-echelon logistics personnel receive standard provisions, while frontline combat units are kept well-fed and ready for action. If managing such details isn't your style, this aspect won’t penalize you or block your progress in combat operations. However, better-fed soldiers will fight more effectively and exhibit greater resistance to injuries and illness. *Plenty of protein makes soldiers stronger, vitamins help them fight off infections, a small snack adds a touch of dignity to dinner, and a drink can make even the blandest meal easier to swallow. Battlefield rescue — time is life. Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare provides a detailed and smooth battlefield rescue experience. From emergency treatment on the field to the transfer of the wounded, to surgery at the aid point and medical evacuation — you need to quickly judge based on the situation: whether to risk using helicopters to evacuate from the combat zone, or play it safe and use armored vehicles for transport. Having the medical team accompany can also buy more time for the wounded. Although survival ultimately depends on fate, rest assured — Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare will not let your efforts go to waste. Game events with unique perspectives. Receive frontline journalists for interviews. As long as their safety is ensured, the closer they are to the front, the more valuable footage they can get — and the greater the rewards you’ll receive. Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare is a game that tells a war story unique to you. Every action of each soldier under your command will be recorded. Even those who die heroically will be remembered by history. You can set a time range, and the system will automatically collect the combat records of troops during that period and compile them into a battle report, restoring your command orders through text. You can personally name each operation — yes, you are also a part of history. Visual Design In addition to gameplay design, Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare has gone to great lengths to enhance immersion through its visual design. Unit Icons The game's unit icons are based on real-world NATO military symbols. When a unit's equipment changes, the icon automatically updates to reflect its current configuration, accurately representing real-world military notation. You can freely customize different unit types to your liking. (Example: When a recon squad boards a pickup truck, its unit icon will change to that of a motorized recon squad.) Destructible Structures In Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare , buildings are composed of modular rooms that react dynamically to player actions. This means destruction is never the same—no two buildings will (probably...) collapse in exactly the same way. 十三、开发过程中的争论、失败和坚持 《阴阳界》的开发并不顺利。 我们曾经制作过一个过于复杂的五行系统，玩家需要同时计算时辰、天气、方位、属性和角色站位。它在设计文档里看起来很有深度，真正玩起来却像完成一道没有乐趣的考试，最终只能推倒重做。 我们也尝试过更加强烈的恐怖表现，但测试玩家反馈，持续刺激会让人疲惫。后来我们减少突然惊吓，转而通过声音、留白和环境细节制造不安。这个过程让我们明白，真正有效的恐怖不在于声音有多大，而在于玩家是否开始怀疑眼前看到的一切。 部分早期方案曾受到.刀劍江湖路.、.黑色沙漠.、.英勇之地.、.漫威爭鋒.、.光與影.和.仙劍奇俠傳.等不同作品风格的影响。团队必须不断提醒自己：灵感可以来自许多地方，但最后呈现的必须是《阴阳界》，而不是各种热门元素的集合。 我们也曾讨论.蘇丹的遊戲.、.苏丹的游戏.、.crab.、.ets.、.吞食天地.、.aoe.、.rivals.、.tes.和.kingdom.等名称所代表或引发的玩法联想。每次讨论结束后，我们都会回到三个问题：它是否符合中式鬼怪世界？它是否能为玩家带来清晰的乐趣？它是否值得玩家投入时间？ 只有同时通过这三个问题的设计，才有机会进入正式版本。 十四、建立真正属于《阴阳界》的角色图鉴 游戏未来会不断增加新的魂灵角色，但数量并不是唯一目标。 在历史与神话题材研究中，我们接触过.三英战吕布.、.虎牢关.、.吕布.、.赵云.、.典韦.、.关羽.、.马超.、.张飞.、.黄忠.、.许褚.、.孙策.、.太史慈.、.夏侯惇.、.夏侯渊.、.张辽.、.张郃.、.徐晃.、.庞德.、.甘宁.、.周泰.、.魏延.、.张绣.、.文丑.、.颜良.、.邓艾.和.姜维.等大众熟悉的人物。 我们也研究过.张让.、.张角.、.张宝.、.张梁.、.张举.、.张济.、.张邈.、.张昭.、.张鲁.、.张南.、.张松.、.张翼.、.张任.、.刘辩.、.刘协.、.刘表.、.刘禅.、.刘封.、.孙坚.、.曹操.、.曹仁.、.曹洪.、.曹休.、.李肃.、.杨修.、.马腾.、.马岱.、.马忠.、.马融.和.韩当.等角色的历史背景。 包括.鲜卑.、.乌桓.、.羌.、.山越.和.南蛮.在内的不同族群资料，也提醒我们：构建文化图鉴时，必须避免用单一视角把复杂历史简化成刻板标签。 这些三国人物不会直接成为《阴阳界》的主角，但研究成熟历史角色如何被大众记忆，能够帮助我们塑造聂小倩、宁采臣、白蛇、青蛇、法海、钟馗、黑白无常和其他传统人物。我们希望多年以后，玩家回忆《阴阳界》时，首先想起的不是某个战力数字，而是一个真正打动过自己的角色。
